data.name: Shristi
data.long_meaning: The power to create or bring about a new beginning, an idea or a work of art. A manifestation of the divine power of creation.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine power of creation and the potential within each individual to create their own destiny.
data.numerology_meaning: A harmonious, loving, and balanced individual who strives for peace and harmony in all areas of life. A natural healer and nurturer, with a strong intuition and a deep understanding of the spiritual world.

in_sanskrit.name: श्रिष्टि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The goddess of creation, prosperity, and welfare. The root word is श्रि (shri) meaning wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.

in_hindi.name: श्रिष्टि
in_hindi.long_meaning: श्रेष्ठ (shreshth) meaning excellent or superior and शुभकारी (shubhkari) meaning auspicious or propitious. Together, it means 'Goddess of Prosperity, Wealth, and Auspiciousness'.

in_tamil.name: ஶ்ரீஷ்ரீதி
in_tamil.meaning: வரும்பு, மக்கள்களுக்கு வாழ்த்தல், வலியல், சிவக்கு, கோபம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: வரும்பு (varumbu) meaning prosperity, மக்கள்களுக்கு (makkalukkku) meaning for the welfare of people, வலியல் (valil) meaning wealth, சிவக்கு (civakku) meaning auspicious, and கோபம் (kopam) meaning desire or wish. Together, it means 'Goddess of Prosperity, Wealth, Desire, and Auspiciousness'.

in_telugu.name: శ్రీష్రీధి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The goddess of prosperity, wealth, and welfare. The root word is శ్రీ (shri) meaning wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.

in_marathi.name: Shristi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shristi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The power to create or bring about a new beginning, an idea or a work of art. A manifestation of the divine power of creation.

in_bengali.name: Shristi
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shristi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The power to create or bring about a new beginning, an idea or a work of art. A manifestation of the divine power of creation.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Shristi" signifies the power of creation and new beginnings in Hindu culture. It is a meaningful name for a child as it instills in them a sense of responsibility and power to bring about positive changes in the world. The name is also commonly used in Hindu art and literature to refer to the divine power of creation.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name "Shristi" is considered to be a divine power, a manifestation of Brahma, the creator god. The name reflects the belief that all creation comes from the divine and that individuals have the power to bring about a new beginning, not just in the physical world but also in their own spiritual growth. The name is a reminder that each of us has the power to create our own lives, our own destinies, and our own karma. It is an inspiring name that encourages individuals to strive for spiritual growth and to use their creative abilities to make a positive impact on the world.

This personification of Shristi reflects the later development of Hinduism, which placed greater emphasis on the worship of gods and goddesses.
